acc1.name: Oath Ring
acc1.flavor: One ring, one person, one promise with no fine print. It has never been taken off. It never will be.

acc2.name: Coat button
acc2.flavor: A single horn button from a winter coat. The coat is gone. The winter isn't.

acc3.name: Knife roll
acc3.flavor: His. Eight knives, every edge shaving-sharp — 'a dull knife is a tired cook.' He fed the whole block out of a kitchen the size of a closet.

acc4.name: Dispatcher's headset
acc4.flavor: One earcup cracked. Her voice came through it on the worst night the town ever had — 'stay with me, stay with me.' It still says it, when it's quiet.

favor.line: "Stay near tonight? Please. I don't want to be alone when the light goes."
favor.whyLine: "I keep hearing things past the treeline. I know it's probably nothing. I just — don't want to be alone with it tonight."
favor.commitLine: "Thank you. Just knowing you're there — it helps."
favor.goodbye: "Tonight, then. I'll be by the fire."
